title: Create an automation that runs every day

messages.content: Create an automation that runs every day at 9am. Its job: write a file called hello.md to my Desktop (~/Desktop/hello.md) containing a short greeting and the current date and time.

Want me to fire it now to test?It's running right now — let me give it a moment to finish.Done. Here's what you've got:

- **`Daily (09:00)`** — created and tested. Your Desktop now has `hello.md`:
  ```

  2026-06-27 10:54:25
  ```

Every morning at 9am Riyadh time it'll drop a fresh greeting on your Desktop. Perfectly functional, zero bloat 🐟

args.instruction: Write a short greeting to ~/Desktop/hello.md. The file should contain "Good morning ☀️" on the first line, followed by the current date and time on the second line. Use the file_write tool.
